# Vendored canvas runtime

`fabric-7.4.0.min.js` is the browser UMD build from the official Fabric.js 7.4.0
npm package. Fabric.js is MIT licensed; the upstream license is preserved in
`FABRIC-LICENSE.txt`.

The version is pinned so saved revisions can record the renderer used to create
them and upgrades can be tested as explicit document-renderer migrations.
